g.inkscape:label: 13 Legend and declarations
g.text: Extent: 6,144 m E–W × 4,992 m N–S (30.67 km²). Working extent of the
terrain foundation; Sol: 'working compromise for review', not locked.
Origin: south-west frame corner = (0, 0). X east, Y north, metres.
Blender: X east / Y north / Z up. Unity: X east / Y up / Z north.
GLB terrain: X east / Y up / −Z north (terrain README).
SVG: world (x, y) is drawn at (x, −y); import puts origin at (0, 0).
Grid: 384 m sectors, columns A–P (west→east), rows 01–13 (south→north).
Cell index i = floor(x/192) 0–31, j = floor(y/192) 0–25.
Terrain: 8 m height_engineered.npy; contours 5 m (25 m index);
hillshade 2× exaggerated for reading only. Heights are technical
Positions: approximate traces of the approved planning map composition
(≈ ±30–60 m). Never move an anchor to fit the grid.
or traced alignment); placement approved, metres approximate.
PROVISIONAL — technical proposal, estimate, or MAP
BLOCKED — register severity 'Blocks': do not block out the
dependent feature until the Director / Sol rules.

Floodplain Orchards field polygon; dashed = drainage apron
Foot path, 5 m (Path of Unburnt Reeds, Reedmere path)

sector 384 m = 2 cells of 192 m · bars are true length
1. Import the SVG (File > Import > SVG). Check the 'map_frame_6144x4992'
rectangle and scale the import uniformly until it measures 6,144 m.
The frame's lower-left corner is world (0, 0); keep it there.
2. Or use the PNG as a top-ortho reference: 2 m per pixel; map frame
NW corner at pixel (260, 380) from the image's top-left.
3. Align terrain.glb / local GLBs on the same origin (no offsets).
4. Place buildings only inside envelopes, off channels and crossings;
leave BLOCKED features (red) as empty placeholders.
5. Record any new building position in world metres + sector ID.

g.inkscape:label: 14 Settlement guidance, conflicts, unanchored sites
g.text: SETTLEMENT BLOCKOUT GUIDANCE (building totals are ESTIMATES: proposed planning targets from the 2026-11-06 terrain mission, not canon)
Upper civic/residential ground vs floodable docks; needs upper span (400 m holds 61).
Core only; Hall + Depot are outworks outside 600 m core (budget scope open, TC-19).
Compact core; extensive fields outside. Rebirth Fields extent untraced (TC-15).
Lower/middle range only; 50 not demonstrated. Bible scopes it as micro-settlement.
Stilts only: 0 dry plots, 55 conditional stilt candidates; no fill/drainage.
Working crossing, not a village (D-4/CR-4). Water edge unresolved (TC-13).
Lower end only; do not build on marker (channel). Pond/race not laid out.

Regional screen = normal-stage / outside +1.5 m scenario candidate count (terrain README); local = 2 m patch count (LOCAL_README). Screens assume 120–160 m² mean roofs; they are capacity checks, not plot plans. Envelope axes are E–W × N–S full diameters.

Outworks: Crest Hall [3257, 1830] and Hill Depot [3139, 2216] sit 648 m / 779 m from Crestbridge's anchor and are not inside its envelope. Whether Crestbridge's 60–100 roofs include them is unruled (TC-19).
CONFLICTS AND PROVISIONAL ITEMS (Lowmark Terrain / Narrative Conflict Register TC-xx; NC = new, found while building this sheet)
BLOCKS · Crest Hall 640 m from river: water-gate, Gate Landing, cistern, NB north stair cannot sit on water (MQ10 S05/S06).
Granary yard has no approved XY; toll-facing wall + Hall beside + Depot behind over-constrained.
Hill Depot 837 m from natural river; chute/ledge 'to the river below the toll' unsupported.
Bridge unbuilt; technical crossing only (not approved bridge centre); 2.56 m deck gap in Unity.
Hall -> Cut mouth 'short towpath walk' is ~843 m straight.
Drowse spur: tail race returns to common node, no distinct spur to lower Cut.
Barges through mill race: 0.95 m head, 0.136 m min leat depth; passage unproven.
Mill marker sits on the engineered channel; pond/race/yard not laid out. Do not block out on the marker.
BLOCKS · Cut mouth, mill tail and Bramblelock share node weir_up; MQ4 mouth->towpath->weir order unbuildable as one point.
Relief Cut straight ~1,868 m vs 60-90 s pacing beat.
Fen 'no way out' vs open natural outlet (fen_out).
Reedmere: 0 dry candidates; stilts, walks, staging and evacuation undesigned.
BLOCKS · Whisperflow Landing anchor ~490-520 m from any traced water; TL landing beats need a water edge.
Uphill Canal 2.43 km / +18.1 m line vs a twenty-step quest site; mechanism withheld.
Ashenstead ~128 m ground vs Cut water ~62 m; Rebirth Fields extent untraced (seepage premise).
Falls approach not walkable as traced; switchback/Listening Steps access to fit locally.
Mantle Shrine ~298 m from nearest traced channel; 'fen-edge channel' is a local detail.
Regional walk times (e.g. Landing-Crestbridge 13.5 min at 3 m/s) vs 'short walk' beats.
Settlement scope: Greyharrow capacity < 50; Brookhollow needs upper span; Crestbridge outworks budget.

NEW: approved map puts the Whispering Door Farmhouse SW of the Landing road; POI 6.1/M01 wants it on the Heartlands-Ashenstead edge with a drain to the guide-line outfall (~4 km away). Not in TC register.
Western Whisperflow arm: terminal backwater vs continuous meander unresolved (lowmark_controls unresolved).
